title: Lakadong Turmeric under Protected Cultivation – Part 9: Pest, Disease, and Soil Biology Management
excerpt: This article examines pest and disease dynamics in Lakadong turmeric under polyhouse cultivation, with emphasis on soil-borne pathogens and biological soil health. It explains how moisture regulation, aeration, and beneficial microorganisms reduce disease incidence and support stable rhizome development. The section positions integrated disease and soil biology management as a preventive, system-level approach essential for producing residue-compliant, high-curcumin Lakadong turmeric for premium markets.
